name: Tenacious
def: Five kilogram European built micro rover with a scoop and an artwork payload, lost when the Resilience lander crashed in June 2025.
body: Tenacious was designed and built in Luxembourg by the European subsidiary of ispace, the first lunar rover manufactured in Europe. It carried a forward scoop to collect regolith under a sample purchase agreement with NASA, plus the Moonhouse artwork by Mikael Genberg, and was to be driven from a control centre in Luxembourg. The Resilience lander of ispace Mission 2 lost its altitude reference and struck the surface on 5 June 2025 with the rover aboard.
facts: First lunar rover built in Europe
Carried a contracted regolith sample purchase for NASA
Lost in the ispace Mission 2 landing failure
specs: Four wheel drive with a fixed regolith scoop
High definition forward camera and navigation cameras
Teleoperated from a European control centre
